# Stockfish 19

ChessLens bundles an unmodified official Stockfish 19 universal macOS binary.

- Project: https://github.com/official-stockfish/Stockfish
- Release: https://github.com/official-stockfish/Stockfish/releases/tag/sf_19
- Exact macOS package: https://github.com/official-stockfish/Stockfish/releases/latest/download/stockfish-macos-universal.tar.gz
- License: GNU General Public License v3; see `Copying.txt` in this directory.

The corresponding source code is available from the release link above and from the
ChessLens source tree. ChessLens does not modify the Stockfish executable.
